guides.description: An antibiotic with a separate periodontal use; COVID-19 and cancer investigations test different biological effects.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Doxycycline combines antibacterial action with investigated effects on inflammation and tumor biology.

sentences.text: Doxycycline combines antibacterial action with investigated effects on inflammation and tumor biology.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: The clearest distinction is between periodontal therapy and acute COVID-19. Low-dose doxycycline is an adjunct to mechanical periodontal treatment; PRINCIPLE did not support routine doxycycline for community COVID-19.

sentences.text: The clearest distinction is between periodontal therapy and acute COVID-19. Low-dose doxycycline is an adjunct to mechanical periodontal treatment; PRINCIPLE did not support routine doxycycline for community COVID-19.

questions.question: Did doxycycline speed recovery from COVID-19?
questions.answer: No clinically meaningful improvement in recovery or COVID-related hospitalization or death was found in PRINCIPLE.

sentences.text: No clinically meaningful improvement in recovery or COVID-related hospitalization or death was found in PRINCIPLE.

questions.question: Does periodontal doxycycline replace dental treatment?
questions.answer: No. The periodontal indication is as an adjunct to scaling and root planing, targeting tissue breakdown.

sentences.text: No. The periodontal indication is as an adjunct to scaling and root planing, targeting tissue breakdown.

questions.question: What do the cancer studies measure?
questions.answer: The breast pilot measured tissue markers; oral and pancreatic models measured invasion, apoptosis, or tumor growth. These outcomes do not provide a patient survival estimate.

sentences.text: The breast pilot measured tissue markers; oral and pancreatic models measured invasion, apoptosis, or tumor growth. These outcomes do not provide a patient survival estimate.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Important risks include photosensitivity, esophageal irritation, severe diarrhea, and intracranial hypertension. Pregnancy and childhood exposure can affect developing teeth and bone.

sentences.text: Important risks include photosensitivity, esophageal irritation, severe diarrhea, and intracranial hypertension. Pregnancy and childhood exposure can affect developing teeth and bone.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Tetracycline hypersensitivity is a contraindication.

sentences.text: Tetracycline hypersensitivity is a contraindication.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Iron, bismuth, and antacids containing calcium, magnesium, or aluminum impair absorption. Some anticonvulsants shorten doxycycline exposure; anticoagulant effects may require adjustment.

sentences.text: Iron, bismuth, and antacids containing calcium, magnesium, or aluminum impair absorption. Some anticonvulsants shorten doxycycline exposure; anticoagulant effects may require adjustment.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The periodontal trial evaluated 20 mg twice daily for nine months alongside scaling and root planing.

sentences.text: The periodontal trial evaluated 20 mg twice daily for nine months alongside scaling and root planing.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: PRINCIPLE studied higher-risk community patients during acute illness. Its negative result answers an outpatient COVID-19 question; it does not assess treatment of a separate susceptible bacterial infection.

sentences.text: PRINCIPLE studied higher-risk community patients during acute illness. Its negative result answers an outpatient COVID-19 question; it does not assess treatment of a separate susceptible bacterial infection.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: The 20 mg periodontal product targets host collagenase activity; it is a different therapeutic regimen from antibacterial doxycycline.

sentences.text: The 20 mg periodontal product targets host collagenase activity; it is a different therapeutic regimen from antibacterial doxycycline.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: US labeling includes bacterial infections and a separate adjunctive periodontal product. Cancer applications remain experimental.

sentences.text: US labeling includes bacterial infections and a separate adjunctive periodontal product. Cancer applications remain experimental.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: PRINCIPLE compared doxycycline with usual care in a randomized community platform trial. Cancer hypotheses concern mitochondrial dependence and cannot supply a patient survival estimate for doxycycline.

sentences.text: PRINCIPLE compared doxycycline with usual care in a randomized community platform trial. Cancer hypotheses concern mitochondrial dependence and cannot supply a patient survival estimate for doxycycline.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: Periodontitis targets tissue breakdown; COVID-19 trials assessed recovery; breast, oral, and pancreatic cancer studies tested distinct tumor mechanisms.

sentences.text: Periodontitis targets tissue breakdown; COVID-19 trials assessed recovery; breast, oral, and pancreatic cancer studies tested distinct tumor mechanisms.

sections.label: Research
sections.paragraph: A central cancer question is whether a tolerable exposure can disrupt tumor mitochondrial function sufficiently to improve response to treatment.

sentences.text: A central cancer question is whether a tolerable exposure can disrupt tumor mitochondrial function sufficiently to improve response to treatment.

faqs.question: Is the periodontal dose intended to kill bacteria?
faqs.answer: Its therapeutic rationale is inhibition of collagenase activity rather than an antibacterial treatment dose.

sentences.text: Its therapeutic rationale is inhibition of collagenase activity rather than an antibacterial treatment dose.

guides.description: Disulfiram’s copper-dependent anticancer hypothesis has reached human trials, with a negative randomized glioblastoma result.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Disulfiram’s alcohol-deterrent action is distinct from its copper-dependent anticancer chemistry.

sentences.text: Disulfiram’s alcohol-deterrent action is distinct from its copper-dependent anticancer chemistry.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: The recurrent glioblastoma trial found no significant six-month survival advantage from adding disulfiram and copper to chemotherapy, while severe adverse events increased.

sentences.text: The recurrent glioblastoma trial found no significant six-month survival advantage from adding disulfiram and copper to chemotherapy, while severe adverse events increased.

questions.question: Did disulfiram improve survival in recurrent glioblastoma?
questions.answer: The randomized trial did not demonstrate a significant survival improvement with the added disulfiram–copper regimen.

sentences.text: The randomized trial did not demonstrate a significant survival improvement with the added disulfiram–copper regimen.

questions.question: Do the other cancer investigations establish the same clinical result?
questions.answer: Breast, melanoma, lung, prostate, and colorectal investigations involve different tumor biology and experimental settings. The mechanistic reports describe tumor-cell effects rather than a shared survival benefit.

sentences.text: Breast, melanoma, lung, prostate, and colorectal investigations involve different tumor biology and experimental settings. The mechanistic reports describe tumor-cell effects rather than a shared survival benefit.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Disulfiram can cause severe hepatitis and peripheral neuropathy. Alcohol exposure can trigger flushing, vomiting, hypotension, and serious cardiovascular reactions.

sentences.text: Disulfiram can cause severe hepatitis and peripheral neuropathy. Alcohol exposure can trigger flushing, vomiting, hypotension, and serious cardiovascular reactions.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Severe myocardial disease or coronary occlusion, psychosis, and hypersensitivity are contraindications. Alcohol-containing preparations and metronidazole must be avoided.

sentences.text: Severe myocardial disease or coronary occlusion, psychosis, and hypersensitivity are contraindications. Alcohol-containing preparations and metronidazole must be avoided.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Alcohol reactions can occur for up to two weeks after stopping disulfiram. Interactions with phenytoin and oral anticoagulants can increase their effects.

sentences.text: Alcohol reactions can occur for up to two weeks after stopping disulfiram. Interactions with phenytoin and oral anticoagulants can increase their effects.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: Glioblastoma treatment combined oral disulfiram and copper with alkylating chemotherapy.

sentences.text: Glioblastoma treatment combined oral disulfiram and copper with alkylating chemotherapy.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: Grade 3 or worse adverse events occurred in 34% of the combination group versus 11% of the chemotherapy-only group in the recurrent glioblastoma trial.

sentences.text: Grade 3 or worse adverse events occurred in 34% of the combination group versus 11% of the chemotherapy-only group in the recurrent glioblastoma trial.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: Disulfiram alone and disulfiram combined with copper are distinct experimental interventions because copper affects the proposed antitumor chemistry.

sentences.text: Disulfiram alone and disulfiram combined with copper are distinct experimental interventions because copper affects the proposed antitumor chemistry.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: US disulfiram labeling concerns alcohol dependence. Its anticancer investigations do not constitute labeled cancer indications.

sentences.text: US disulfiram labeling concerns alcohol dependence. Its anticancer investigations do not constitute labeled cancer indications.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The glioblastoma study randomized 88 patients and compared the added regimen with chemotherapy alone. This is more direct clinical evidence than tumor-cell experiments.

sentences.text: The glioblastoma study randomized 88 patients and compared the added regimen with chemotherapy alone. This is more direct clinical evidence than tumor-cell experiments.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: Glioblastoma addresses survival during recurrent disease; breast, lung, melanoma, prostate, and colorectal investigations explore tumor sensitivity to disulfiram and copper.

sentences.text: Glioblastoma addresses survival during recurrent disease; breast, lung, melanoma, prostate, and colorectal investigations explore tumor sensitivity to disulfiram and copper.

sections.label: Research
sections.paragraph: Identifying tumor susceptibility and achieving useful exposure without additional toxicity are central problems for copper-dependent disulfiram strategies.

sentences.text: Identifying tumor susceptibility and achieving useful exposure without additional toxicity are central problems for copper-dependent disulfiram strategies.

faqs.question: Can alcohol in medicines matter during disulfiram treatment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Alcohol-containing medicines can provoke the same disulfiram–alcohol reaction as alcoholic drinks.

sentences.text: Yes. Alcohol-containing medicines can provoke the same disulfiram–alcohol reaction as alcoholic drinks.

guides.description: A beta blocker being studied for the effects of stress signaling on cancer progression.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Propranolol blocks adrenergic signaling in cardiovascular use and tumor investigations.

sentences.text: Propranolol blocks adrenergic signaling in cardiovascular use and tumor investigations.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: A breast trial found short-term tumor-marker changes. A nine-patient melanoma combination study reported responses, but its single-arm design cannot isolate propranolol’s contribution.

sentences.text: A breast trial found short-term tumor-marker changes. A nine-patient melanoma combination study reported responses, but its single-arm design cannot isolate propranolol’s contribution.

questions.question: What changed in the breast cancer trial?
questions.answer: Mesenchymal gene expression decreased; the trial also found changes in immune-cell markers associated with the tumor environment.

sentences.text: Mesenchymal gene expression decreased; the trial also found changes in immune-cell markers associated with the tumor environment.

questions.question: Does a biomarker response mean longer survival?
questions.answer: The preoperative trial measured tissue biology during a brief treatment window, not long-term survival.

sentences.text: The preoperative trial measured tissue biology during a brief treatment window, not long-term survival.

questions.question: What did the melanoma combination study find?
questions.answer: Seven of nine patients responded to propranolol plus pembrolizumab; no dose-limiting toxicity occurred. The trial’s main aim was dose selection.

sentences.text: Seven of nine patients responded to propranolol plus pembrolizumab; no dose-limiting toxicity occurred. The trial’s main aim was dose selection.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Propranolol can cause bradycardia, hypotension, and bronchospasm. Abrupt withdrawal can worsen angina; beta blockade can mask warning signs of hypoglycemia.

sentences.text: Propranolol can cause bradycardia, hypotension, and bronchospasm. Abrupt withdrawal can worsen angina; beta blockade can mask warning signs of hypoglycemia.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Bronchial asthma, cardiogenic shock, sinus bradycardia, and greater-than-first-degree heart block are contraindications.

sentences.text: Bronchial asthma, cardiogenic shock, sinus bradycardia, and greater-than-first-degree heart block are contraindications.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Verapamil or diltiazem can compound slowing of heart rate and conduction; other blood-pressure-lowering medicines can increase hypotension.

sentences.text: Verapamil or diltiazem can compound slowing of heart rate and conduction; other blood-pressure-lowering medicines can increase hypotension.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The breast trial administered propranolol during the week before surgery, a brief perioperative strategy rather than prolonged cancer treatment.

sentences.text: The breast trial administered propranolol during the week before surgery, a brief perioperative strategy rather than prolonged cancer treatment.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: The melanoma study reported a 78% objective response rate at six months, with one patient experiencing grade 3 or worse treatment-related events.

sentences.text: The melanoma study reported a 78% objective response rate at six months, with one patient experiencing grade 3 or worse treatment-related events.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: Immediate-release and extended-release propranolol products have different release profiles; the formulation and timing define the regimen being studied.

sentences.text: Immediate-release and extended-release propranolol products have different release profiles; the formulation and timing define the regimen being studied.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: Propranolol has established labeled cardiovascular and other noncancer uses. The breast, melanoma, pancreatic, and prostate investigations examine additional oncologic roles.

sentences.text: Propranolol has established labeled cardiovascular and other noncancer uses. The breast, melanoma, pancreatic, and prostate investigations examine additional oncologic roles.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The breast trial randomized a short presurgical intervention; the melanoma trial evaluated dose escalation without a pembrolizumab-only control.

sentences.text: The breast trial randomized a short presurgical intervention; the melanoma trial evaluated dose escalation without a pembrolizumab-only control.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The four cancer settings examine different consequences of adrenergic signaling: breast invasion markers, melanoma immunity, pancreatic innervation, and prostate PKA activity.

sentences.text: The four cancer settings examine different consequences of adrenergic signaling: breast invasion markers, melanoma immunity, pancreatic innervation, and prostate PKA activity.

sections.label: Research
sections.paragraph: The key clinical question is whether beta blockade improves cancer outcomes beyond the effects of its partner treatment.

sentences.text: The key clinical question is whether beta blockade improves cancer outcomes beyond the effects of its partner treatment.

faqs.question: Why is surgery a research window?
faqs.answer: The interval before surgery allows tumor tissue to be compared after brief exposure to beta blockade.

sentences.text: The interval before surgery allows tumor tissue to be compared after brief exposure to beta blockade.

guides.description: A cholesterol-lowering statin tested in cancer and vitiligo, with negative results in specific randomized studies.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Simvastatin reduces cholesterol and cardiovascular risk in its established uses. Repurposing studies test effects on tumor metabolism and immune-mediated pigment loss.

sentences.text: Simvastatin reduces cholesterol and cardiovascular risk in its established uses. Repurposing studies test effects on tumor metabolism and immune-mediated pigment loss.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: Adding simvastatin to gemcitabine did not improve time to progression in an advanced pancreatic cancer trial. A small oral simvastatin trial also found no repigmentation advantage in vitiligo.

sentences.text: Adding simvastatin to gemcitabine did not improve time to progression in an advanced pancreatic cancer trial. A small oral simvastatin trial also found no repigmentation advantage in vitiligo.

questions.question: Did simvastatin help gemcitabine work better?
questions.answer: The randomized pancreatic trial did not show an efficacy advantage for the addition of simvastatin.

sentences.text: The randomized pancreatic trial did not show an efficacy advantage for the addition of simvastatin.

questions.question: Did oral simvastatin restore pigment in vitiligo?
questions.answer: The small placebo-controlled trial did not show improved repigmentation.

sentences.text: The small placebo-controlled trial did not show improved repigmentation.

questions.question: What was seen in myeloma experiments?
questions.answer: The cell-line study found reduced viability and decreased IL-6 secretion in U266 cells; it did not administer simvastatin to patients.

sentences.text: The cell-line study found reduced viability and decreased IL-6 secretion in U266 cells; it did not administer simvastatin to patients.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Muscle injury, including rhabdomyolysis, and liver injury are important risks. Higher exposure and interacting drugs increase muscle toxicity.

sentences.text: Muscle injury, including rhabdomyolysis, and liver injury are important risks. Higher exposure and interacting drugs increase muscle toxicity.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Acute liver failure or decompensated cirrhosis and several exposure-raising drug combinations are contraindications.

sentences.text: Acute liver failure or decompensated cirrhosis and several exposure-raising drug combinations are contraindications.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, cyclosporine, gemfibrozil, and danazol are contraindicated combinations. Grapefruit can increase exposure.

sentences.text: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors, cyclosporine, gemfibrozil, and danazol are contraindicated combinations. Grapefruit can increase exposure.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The pancreatic trial studied simvastatin 40 mg daily alongside gemcitabine.

sentences.text: The pancreatic trial studied simvastatin 40 mg daily alongside gemcitabine.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: Median time to progression was 2.4 months with simvastatin–gemcitabine versus 3.6 months with placebo–gemcitabine; the difference was not significant.

sentences.text: Median time to progression was 2.4 months with simvastatin–gemcitabine versus 3.6 months with placebo–gemcitabine; the difference was not significant.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: Oral systemic treatment and a topical skin formulation create different exposure patterns. The oral vitiligo trial answers the question for its oral regimen.

sentences.text: Oral systemic treatment and a topical skin formulation create different exposure patterns. The oral vitiligo trial answers the question for its oral regimen.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: The US indication concerns lipid lowering and cardiovascular risk reduction. The pancreatic cancer and vitiligo regimens discussed here were experimental.

sentences.text: The US indication concerns lipid lowering and cardiovascular risk reduction. The pancreatic cancer and vitiligo regimens discussed here were experimental.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The pancreatic study randomized 114 patients. Its result concerns an add-on to gemcitabine, while the much smaller vitiligo trial evaluated a different disease and outcome.

sentences.text: The pancreatic study randomized 114 patients. Its result concerns an add-on to gemcitabine, while the much smaller vitiligo trial evaluated a different disease and outcome.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: Breast and colorectal cancer and myeloma concern tumor metabolism; pancreatic cancer has a direct gemcitabine comparison; vitiligo concerns autoimmune destruction of melanocytes.

sentences.text: Breast and colorectal cancer and myeloma concern tumor metabolism; pancreatic cancer has a direct gemcitabine comparison; vitiligo concerns autoimmune destruction of melanocytes.

sections.label: Research
sections.paragraph: The remaining biological question is whether particular tumor or immune contexts respond at exposures that avoid muscle and liver toxicity.

sentences.text: The remaining biological question is whether particular tumor or immune contexts respond at exposures that avoid muscle and liver toxicity.

faqs.question: Is cholesterol reduction evidence of a cancer response?
faqs.answer: The pancreatic trial measured tumor progression separately from simvastatin’s established lipid-lowering action.

sentences.text: The pancreatic trial measured tumor progression separately from simvastatin’s established lipid-lowering action.

guides.description: An intestinal tapeworm drug whose cancer studies depend on signaling targets and achievable systemic exposure.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Niclosamide treats intestinal tapeworms; systemic tumor treatment poses a separate absorption problem.

sentences.text: Niclosamide treats intestinal tapeworms; systemic tumor treatment poses a separate absorption problem.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: The five-patient prostate trial found no PSA declines and dose-limiting gastrointestinal toxicity. Other tumor findings concern experimental models.

sentences.text: The five-patient prostate trial found no PSA declines and dose-limiting gastrointestinal toxicity. Other tumor findings concern experimental models.

questions.question: Did the prostate trial show an anticancer response?
questions.answer: No PSA reductions were observed in this small dose-finding study.

sentences.text: No PSA reductions were observed in this small dose-finding study.

questions.question: What did the colorectal experiments show?
questions.answer: Niclosamide enhanced SN38-induced cytotoxicity in cell lines; the strongest sequence delivered SN38 before niclosamide.

sentences.text: Niclosamide enhanced SN38-induced cytotoxicity in cell lines; the strongest sequence delivered SN38 before niclosamide.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Reported effects include gastrointestinal symptoms, dizziness, and allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis. The cancer trial found dose-limiting gastrointestinal toxicity.

sentences.text: Reported effects include gastrointestinal symptoms, dizziness, and allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis. The cancer trial found dose-limiting gastrointestinal toxicity.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Hypersensitivity to niclosamide or an ingredient is a contraindication.

sentences.text: Hypersensitivity to niclosamide or an ingredient is a contraindication.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Alcohol can increase niclosamide absorption; the Yomesan label advises against concurrent alcohol-containing beverages.

sentences.text: Alcohol can increase niclosamide absorption; the Yomesan label advises against concurrent alcohol-containing beverages.
